title: Yixuan39/targetasm pipeline parameters
description: Reference-independent assembly of target genomes from mixed long-read samples

input.description: Samplesheet (CSV or TSV) with a reads column and optional sample and target_bases columns.
input.help_text: One row per sample. `reads` is a PacBio HiFi FASTQ file (.fastq/.fq, optionally gzipped). `sample` names the outputs; leave it out to use the reads file name (isolate1.fastq.gz -> isolate1). `target_bases` overrides --target_bases for that sample; leave it empty to use --target_bases.
input.errorMessage: The samplesheet must be an existing .csv or .tsv file with no spaces in its path

gx_db.help_text: The complete database is about 470 GB and FCS-GX needs about 500 GB of RAM to screen against it. Since 0.2.0 this is the directory itself, not the `all` file prefix used by 0.1.0.
gx_db.errorMessage: --gx_db must be an existing directory that contains the FCS-GX database (all.gxi, all.gxs, ...), not the 'all' file prefix used by targetasm 0.1.0. Download: https://github.com/ncbi/fcs/wiki/FCS-GX-quickstart

tax_id.description: NCBI taxonomy ID of the target organism or clade, used by FCS-GX (e.g. 4762 for Oomycota).

keep_intermediates.description: Publish intermediate assemblies and recruited reads.

target_bases.description: Optional target number of recruited bases; omit to retain all mapped reads.
target_bases.help_text: Accepts a positive whole number of bases, including integer-valued scientific notation (e.g. 5e9 or 5.4e9). Values are checked for exact integer conversion before tasks start. A samplesheet target_bases value overrides this for that sample.
target_bases.errorMessage: --target_bases must be a whole number of bases, e.g. 5400000000 or 5.4e9

rasusa_seed.description: Random seed for subsampling recruited reads.

hifiasm_option.description: Extra hifiasm arguments; --primary is always added.

threads.description: CPUs for multi-threaded tasks; also sets their memory to 8 GB per thread. FCS-GX always requests 500 GB.
threads.help_text: metaMDBG, minimap2, hifiasm, Compleasm, QUAST and FCS-GX use this many CPUs. All of them except FCS-GX request 8 GB of memory per thread (24 threads = 192 GB), so lower --threads on smaller machines.

quality_library.description: Local Compleasm library directory, e.g. from `compleasm download <lineage> -L <dir>`; providing it enables QC.

quality_lineage.description: Compleasm lineage name, required when quality_library is supplied.

help.description: Print the parameter help message and exit.
